classification.difficultyReason: Find the initial population and substitute five years, then translate those results into labelled points and an increasing exponential sketch on unscaled axes.

content.prompt: A population $P$ is to be modelled using the function $P = 2000(1.2)^t$ where $t$ is the time in years.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Find the population after 5 years. Answer to the nearest whole.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{aligned}P&=2000(1.2)^5\\P&=4976.64\\P&\approx4977.\end{aligned}$$
The population after 5 years is 4977, to the nearest whole.

children.label: c
children.prompt: On the axes, sketch the population against time, showing the points at $t = 0$ and $t = 5$.
